siteTagline.en: Uzbekistan, in the order that makes sense

heroTitle.en: Four cities, one road, no backtracking

heroSubtitle.en: Pick the cities you want. We put them in the order the Silk Road already put them, tell you how far it is, and how many days you need.

companyDescription.en: Karvon is a small travel outfit based in Samarkand. We build routes across Uzbekistan for independent travellers and run fixed one-, two- and three-day tours in each of the four main cities.

aboutBlurb.en: We are guides first. Every place on this site is somewhere we take people ourselves, which is why there are twenty-six of them and not two hundred.

footerText.en: Karvon Travel — Samarkand, Uzbekistan. Demo content; replace it in the admin panel.
